title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetService
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetService. This class is a representation of a set function to a network that makes the function discoverable, registerable, remotely controllable by other devices in the network. Subclass of saref:Service (core SAREF).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SetService'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasOperation.description: Relationship (saref:hasOperation, core SAREF). Links this set service to the SetOperation that carries out the actual exchange.
